verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents built-in RAG that retrieves relevant information from supplied sources and incorporates it into chat responses, including multimedia sources. One community user cites its RAG integrations as a strength. However, two hands-on reports say RAG never worked for them on CPU-only or external-API setups, a significant caveat for some deployments. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of a persistent knowledge-base or collection feature for attaching documents and notes, citation or grounding detail in the docs, and reliable RAG on non-GPU setups.
